findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：產業正經歷電動化與數位化的重大技術變革，新進者與中國本土供應商（財務報酬要求較低）挑戰既有供應商市佔；若無法差異化或維持低成本，可能失去市佔或被迫降價。
findings.excerpt: Chinese domestic suppliers that may have lower financial return expectations are also challenging traditional automotive suppliers for market share. Further, the global automotive industry is experiencing a period of significant technological change, including in the areas of electrification and digitization.

findings.claim: 10-K 列示自家替代性產品：FlexAir 為傳統發泡的 100% 可回收替代、SoyFoam 為部分石油基產品替代；經查搜尋未見有具名的外部替代技術取代 Lear 座椅核心產品之來源。
findings.excerpt: We have developed products such as FlexAir®, a 100% recyclable alternative to traditional foam, ReNewKnit®, a sustainable sueded alternative material that is fully recyclable at its end of life

substitute_technology.note: 僅下 1 次搜尋，結果未提供具名替代技術威脅來源；其餘依一手 10-K 摘錄。
